description: This file defines the 'Tracing' class which manages tracing operations such as start, stop, grouping, and stack collection within the Playwright core library. It handles trace artifacts, file saving, and interaction with external utilities.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class that manages tracing sessions, including starting, stopping, grouping, and saving trace data, with support for live tracing and source inclusion.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Tracing instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Tracing object with parent, type, guid, and initializer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a tracing session with optional parameters like name, title, snapshots, screenshots, sources, and live mode.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk with optional name and title.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group, optionally with a source file location.

methods.name: _startCollectingStacks
methods.description: Begins collecting stack traces, setting internal state and calling local utilities.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally saving to a specified file path.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracing session and finalizes trace data, optionally saving to a file.

methods.name: _doStopChunk
methods.description: Handles the logic for stopping a trace chunk, saving or discarding artifacts.
